items.title: Harrison Verrett Interview, 1961-08-10
items.q: I never played with him, but I have played with him recently.

ctx.x: I mentioned that we're interviewing Mr. Harrison Barrett and the address is 2401 Jordan Avenue and the date is August the 10th 1961 and this is Bill Russell and Ralph Collins interviewing. Now you want to give your full name Harrison?
Did you play with Red Dallin in the old days too, around here?
